doorwayPosition.description: {doorway: id}: in a doorway, on its sill.

facing.description: A yaw in degrees, {yaw}, or {toward: id | position}.

generic.description: Any actor: its class, where it is and raw properties.

height.description: A height in a room: "floor+N" or "ceiling-N".

id.description: Names one thing in the level; unique ignoring case; becomes its create id and Tag.

inPosition.description: {in: piece, u, v, h}: a point inside a geometry piece.

atResetEvent.description: Event sent once when the mode starts.

nearPosition.description: {near: id, offset}: beside another thing in the spec.

point.description: [x, y] or [x, y, z]; z may be "floor+N" or "ceiling-N" of the room under the point, and a missing z takes the usual height for the thing placed.

position.description: [x, y, z] | {in, u, v, h} | {near, offset} | {doorway}

props.description: Raw map-changes property values, written as given: leaves are strings, structs objects, arrays arrays, {"$ref": id} for actors.

description: A whole SCCT Versus level for the RE+ MCP level_build tool. Lengths are in units{unit} (Unreal units by default), yaw in degrees, Z up, east +X, north +Y.

cone.description: LightCone of the spot preset: the beam's width, larger is wider. Default: the class's.

class.description: Volume, SDamageVolume, ERainVolume, BlockingVolume or a full class name.

sendAtTime.description: Seconds; negative counts back from the end of the match.

anyOf.description: {id, at}: a new SFlagDropZone; give it an id to share it.
{ref: id}: the drop zone another flag's entry made, shared.

items.description: {id, at} for a new SFlagDropZone, or {ref: id} to share one another flag made (flags may share drop zones).

sizes.description: Objectives to win at 1v1 .. 8v8; 0 keeps the mission's own.
Objectives to win at 1v1 .. 8v8; 0 keeps the mission's own.

portal.description: A zone portal in the opening. Default: true, or with zones only where it joins two zones.

attach.description: Flush against the outside of another piece's wall, running away from it.

offset.description: Along the wall: east of the centre on a north or south wall, north of it on an east or west wall.

size.description: [width (local X), length (local Y), height]; a corridor, vent or crawlway is open at both ends of its length.

yaw.description: Degrees; multiples of 90 keep walls on the compass.

faces.description: Faces by the way their surface faces: a carved room's east wall faces west (-X).

sendAtTime.description: Seconds; negative counts back from the end of the match.

file.description: File stem; default the first four letters of the name and D.

carDoorMesh.description: Static mesh of the car's SLiftDoor; default doorMesh.

carSwitch.description: The switch inside the car, which rides with it (AttachTag). Default true.

doorMesh.description: Static mesh of each storey's external door (a Mover: Key 0 open, Key 1 closed). Without it the lift has no doors.

doorOpen.description: How a lift door opens from closed: {offset} or {yaw}. Default: up by its height.

items.description: Where one storey's external door goes, when no doorway of the spec joins that storey to the shaft (or another than the one found).

mesh.description: The car: an SLift static mesh. Without it a two-storey lift is a design.lift platform.

switches.description: A call switch on each storey and one in the car. Default true.

release.description: Release notes and options, kept with the spec.

anyOf.description: Starts on a 128-unit lattice at floor+48 in one or more rooms.
Starts on a 128-unit lattice at floor+48 in one or more rooms.

enabledBy.description: The event Tag that toggles it.

portals.description: Portals where its spaces meet other zones; default true.
